text: OSINTdefender A new Congressional Budget Office report on the costs of Operation Epic Fury was released today, and it contains a notable table detailing U.S. battle losses. The table lists the loss of two KC-135 Stratotankers and one F-35A. To date, the Department of War has publicly acknowledged the loss of only one KC-135, which was destroyed in a crash over western Iraq. text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT OSINTdefender The FBI arrested a 21-year-old Pennsylvania man allegedly preparing for an ISIS inspired mass casualty attack, according to the Justice Department. Federal prosecutors say Jonathan Hunter Kramer had been investigated previously for a mass-casualty plot and, after his release from juvenile detention in March, resumed extremist activity online. Investigators say he claimed affiliation with ISIS, discussed explosive manuals and said he was preparing for a “mission” but needed a weapon. The FBI arrested Kramer on Sept. 12 after observing him obtain a disposable phone, acquire a long black bag and visit a sporting-goods store's gun counter. Searches allegedly recovered a semiautomatic rifle, five magazines, 190 rounds of ammunition, a bipod and scope, an entrenchment tool, pepper spray and approximately 30 knives. He faces a federal charge for receiving a firearm or ammunition knowing or having reason to believe it would be used in a federal crime of terrorism. Prosecutors are seeking detention without bond. tweet

text: Exclusive photos obtained by CBS News show extensive damage at multiple U.S. military positions in the Middle East following Iranian missile and drone attacks. The images, provided by anonymous active-duty service members, show destroyed buildings, vehicles and equipment at bases in Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. At Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia, a Boeing E-3 Sentry aircraft was struck, with its tail section severed. At Camp Buehring and Camp Arifjan in Kuwait, photos show damaged barracks, trailers and vehicles. A deployed service member told CBS News: This is major damage to our bases that hasn't been communicated to the American public. We're standing there with our eyes closed getting punched in the face. Another service member criticized U.S. defenses, saying: We're not defending these bases. We're just watching them get destroyed.
text_zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（CBS News）获得的独家照片显示，在伊朗导弹和无人机袭击后，美国在中东的多个军事阵地遭受了严重破坏。这些由匿名现役军人提供的图像显示，沙特阿拉伯和科威特的基地内建筑物、车辆和设备被毁。在沙特阿拉伯的苏丹王子空军基地，一架波音E-3哨兵预警机被击中，尾部断裂。在科威特的布埃林营地和阿里夫詹营地，照片显示营房、拖车和车辆受损。一名部署的军人告诉CBS新闻：“这对我们的基地造成了重大破坏，但并没有向美国公众通报。我们站在那里闭着眼睛挨打。”另一名军人批评了美国的防御，称：“我们根本没有在保卫这些基地。我们只是眼睁睁地看着它们被摧毁。”

text: Nuno Felix RT @RufoAlice : « Au tout début de la guerre, nous étions très clairs sur ce que nous ne ferions pas pour soutenir l'Ukraine, et c'était une erreur. Nous nous sommes imposés nos propres lignes rouges. Nous avons changé cela. Pour Poutine, absolument tout est une "escalade" : livrer des chars, des avions de combat, des capacités à longue portée, ou aujourd'hui offrir des garanties de sécurité. Tout devient une soi-disant ligne rouge. Nous avons besoin de plus d'ambiguïté stratégique. Nous devons être clairs sur un fait : nous allons défendre l'Ukraine, nous allons défendre l'Europe, sans prendre en compte en permanence cette menace d'escalade qui n'est pas réelle. » tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 转推 @RufoAlice ：« 在战争刚开始时，我们对于不做什么来支持乌克兰非常明确，那是一个错误。我们给自己设定了红线。我们改变了这一点。对于普京来说，绝对一切都是“升级”：运送坦克、战斗机、远程能力，或者今天提供安全保障。一切都变成了所谓的红线。我们需要更多的战略模糊性。我们必须明确一个事实：我们将保卫乌克兰，我们将保卫欧洲，而不必一直考虑这种并不真实的升级威胁。 » 推文

text: Nuno Felix This is how Putin wins. There is no one planning is dismissal. Like a typical school bully, Putin is deliberately provoking his European classmates in the hope that they will overreact. A disproportionate response to Putin’s sub-threshold attacks would allow him to commit more serious acts of aggression and to justify these as self-defence. But we should see this behaviour for what it is: a desperate dictator trying to cling on to power by any means, including triggering a major conflict. Europe must hold its nerve while those inside Russia (who understand that Putin is only destroying his own country) plot his removal. - Nicholas Drummond tweet
text_zh: Nuno Felix 这就是普京获胜的方式。没有人计划罢免他。就像典型的校园恶霸一样，普京故意挑衅他的欧洲同学，希望他们反应过度。对普京的阈下攻击做出不成比例的反应，将使他能够实施更严重的侵略行为，并将其辩解为自卫。但我们应该看清这种行为的本质：一个绝望的独裁者试图通过任何手段（包括引发重大冲突）来维持权力。欧洲必须保持冷静，而俄罗斯内部那些明白普京只会摧毁自己国家的人则在策划他的下台。 - Nicholas Drummond 推文
